overview: Generate a formal FY2024 frozen-input research report for Alphabet (GOOGL) covering executive summary, three statements or gaps, valuation or limitation, risks, and investment conclusion, with explicit citations.
requirements: Cover executive summary, three statements or gaps, valuation or limitation, risks, and investment conclusion.
Emit explicitly labeled critical claims and body citations.

tasks.description: Gather frozen snapshot evidence for Alphabet (GOOGL) FY2024: financial statements (balance sheet, income statement, cash flow), market data (stock price, shares outstanding), and any relevant news or analyst estimates. Use frozen snapshot only.
tasks.expected_output: A set of evidence records with evidence_ids for each data point, including balance sheet, income statement, cash flow, stock price, and shares outstanding.

tasks.description: Perform financial statement analysis on GOOGL FY2024 evidence: compute key ratios (e.g., P/E, EPS, revenue growth, profit margins, debt-to-equity), build three-statement view, and conduct valuation using DCF or multiples. Identify any gaps in data.
tasks.expected_output: Evidence-backed claims with tables for financial metrics, valuation estimate, and gap notes. All numeric claims retain evidence_ids.

tasks.description: Analyze risks and limitations based on GOOGL FY2024 evidence: identify key risk factors (e.g., regulatory, competition, macroeconomic), assess financial health limitations, and list material uncertainties. Use frozen snapshot evidence only.
tasks.expected_output: List of risk claims with evidence_ids, and a limitations section noting data constraints.

tasks.description: Assemble the final FY2024 frozen-input report for GOOGL. Include sections: Executive Summary, Three Statements or Gaps, Valuation or Limitation, Risks, Investment Conclusion. Embed all critical claims with body citations (evidence_id). Use markdown format initially.
tasks.expected_output: Markdown report with all required sections and inline citations.

tasks.description: Verify the final report: check every material factual claim has an evidence_id citation, confirm only frozen snapshot evidence was used, ensure all required sections are present, and compliance with constraints. Provide pass/fail and revision instructions if needed.
tasks.expected_output: Verification result: pass or revision brief with specific issues.

data_sources: Frozen snapshot of Alphabet (GOOGL) FY2024 financial statements and market data
